How It Works

  • Calendar shows current and next month.
  • Click any date to view and edit.
  • Mark unavailable hours by dragging on the timeline.
  • Save and your calendar updates instantly.

Key Points

  • Default assumption: You are available.
  • You only mark the hours you are unavailable.
  • Changes reflect immediately on the calendar.
  • Use Quick Actions to save time.

Legend

  • AvailableMarked available
  • UnavailableLeave / blocked
  • AssignmentAlready booked
  • TravelFlight scheduled
  • ILO OffNight / Morning / Evening

Tip

Drag on the timeline for quick selection of multiple hours. Double-click a slot to start a range and single-click another to fill everything in between.
